from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f05bd3b0.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Hollow rectangular outlines are filled according to their side length:
    # odd-sized frames get 7; even-sized frames get 2.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            r0 = min(x for x,y in cells); r1 = max(x for x,y in cells)
            c0 = min(y for x,y in cells); c1 = max(y for x,y in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Only act on a complete one-cell-thick rectangular outline.
            boundary = {(rr,cc) for rr in range(r0,r1+1) for cc in range(c0,c1+1)
                        if rr in (r0,r1) or cc in (c0,c1)}
            if not boundary.issubset(set(cells)):
                continue
            if any(grid[rr][cc] != bg for rr in range(r0+1,r1) for cc in range(c0+1,c1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 == 1 else 2
            for rr in range(r0+1,r1):
                for cc in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[rr][cc] = fill
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.read_text())
